name: Reciprocating and screw compressors
principle: Positive-displacement machines: crank-driven pistons in cylinders compress gas in a reciprocating compressor, while meshing rotors do so in a screw compressor.

process_steps.name: Piston compresses gas in the cylinder

performance.basis: 5,000 psig stated for multistage reciprocating compressors

source.note: Wikipedia, Reciprocating compressor, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

limitations: The Wikipedia page does not cover screw compressors
